_doc: The Find Me Money campaign's Revenue OS settings: which functions are on, where each starts from in this pack, and what each waits on. Names of things only. Check with python3 tools/check_campaign.py campaigns/find-me-money/campaign.json.

grok.account: the Find Me Money Grok account

offer: Education first on how business funding really works, then the funding itself. Free to the owner; not a lender and not a broker (Justin, 2026-11-24)
icp: People and business owners looking for financing, the creative and alternative ways included; wholesalers; local businesses; the funding community as partners

crm.name: GoHighLevel
crm.note: The CRM job reads, and writes its proposals to requests/justin/, until Justin says gohighlevel: bot and crm-writes: on. If another agent already files and answers there, it is switched off first: two writers never write the same record.

sending.cold_email: partnerships only (Justin, 2026-11-24): the sending tool and domains are his call
sending.social: drafts only until an outlet has a brand account

engines.note: Justin, 2026-11-24: "a hard-baked-in rule that it's using the Claude Code CLI skill... for every task and everything it does. It's just an orchestrator." Every job goes through tools/job.py: Claude Code first, Codex second.

dream-100.waits_on: nothing to build the partner list and draft; a first touch going out waits on the owner's yes

dream-500.waits_on: nothing to build and place the partner list; sending waits on a sending tool and inboxes

partners.waits_on: nothing to screen and draft; the Partnerships job runs it with the two dream lists

cold-email.waits_on: partnerships only: no cold email to a direct lead (Justin, 2026-11-24). The sending tool and domains are his call

lead-radar.waits_on: nothing to read public pages and draft; a members-only Skool or Whop community waits on Justin signing the bot's browser in

content.waits_on: nothing to draft; a post going out waits on a brand account per outlet and the owner's yes

speaker.waits_on: not in this bot (Justin, 2026-11-24: a funding bot, kept focused)

aeo-seo.waits_on: not in this bot (Justin, 2026-11-24: a funding bot, kept focused)

sales-crm.waits_on: the CRM's key and sub-account id; Justin saying gohighlevel: bot and crm-writes: on once no other agent writes there
sales-crm.combined: Replies and the CRM are one job (the owner, 2026-11-17).

reply_rules: no link and no 'DM me' or 'call me' in any public reply (a checker enforces it)
a first reply asks for nothing
Facebook is answered by hired posters (Justin, 2026-11-07) unless he reverses
goal: Justin, 2026-11-24: a funding bot, kept focused. Content more than anything; Lead Radar; Skool and Whop for partnership and outreach; cold email for partnerships only; the GoHighLevel CRM worked hard. The message is campaigns/find-me-money/MESSAGING.md.
